# Astron Collection

> An open-source suite of Discord applications — community, logging, protection
> and voice — built on a shared framework and managed from one console.

Astron Collection is maintained by Sky Genesis Enterprise and licensed under MIT.

## What it is

- **Astron** — community and moderation bot (`bot/main`)
- **Astron Guild** — guild center for community management (`bot/guild`)
- **Astron Logger** — event and audit logging (`bot/logger`)
- **Astron Protect** — moderation, AutoMod and server safety (`bot/protect`)
- **Astron Player** — voice-capable distribution, in development (`bot/player`)
- **Astron Automation** — planned, no release yet

All five distributions currently ship the same 20-command catalogue and differ by
deployment intent. They share one framework: lifecycle, command contract,
interaction routing, four-layer authorisation, structured logs, idempotent
command deployment and voice presence.

## Platform

The console (`apps/astron`) manages servers, applications, databases, domains,
certificates, backups, monitoring, roles, SSO, audit logs and API keys.
Background work (`apps/api`), scheduled jobs (`apps/schedules`), the status page
(`apps/status`) and monitoring (`apps/monitoring`) run alongside it.

Deploy with Docker Compose: PostgreSQL, Redis, client and API. No Traefik, no
Swarm and no host Docker socket is required to run the platform itself.

## Deployment models

- **Self-hosted** — you operate the platform and its data.
- **Astron Collection Cloud** — SGE operates the control plane; workloads stay on
  the servers you connect.

## Developer surfaces

- HTTP API with an OpenAPI 1.0.0 document (724 operations)
- MCP server with 19 workflow-oriented capabilities
- CLI (`astron-collection`), TypeScript SDK, VS Code extension
